## How it works

- [statement] Horizon identifies the SmartSlitter registration camera as optional. Specify that option when evaluating an equipped system. (low confidence) — https://www.horizon.co.jp/products/catalog/e_pdf/e008di/03sms_pdf/smartslitter_e.pdf · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Summa documents a recovery path when the camera cannot recognize printed marks: edit the camera profile or select the current position to identify a poorly printed mark. Automatic registration can require operator intervention. (low confidence) — https://support.summa.eu/support/solutions/articles/43000493939-what-if-goproduce-does-not-recognize-registration-marks- · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] For camera automatic-setup failure, the SmartSlitter manual directs attention to illumination angle and optical focus. Allow troubleshooting effort when evaluating short-run setup burden. (low confidence) — https://www.pfsdocs.com/new-equipment/digital-bindery/slitter-cutter-creasers/technical/Horizon_SmartSlitter_OM.pdf · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] A DC-646 operator reported reliable optical-mark reading on coated substrates but rejection problems on uncoated substrates. This is one attributed stock-dependent failure report, without a verified cause or a population failure-rate estimate. (low confidence) — https://printplanet.com/threads/duplo-dc-646-optical-registration-mark-not-reading.294834/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Canon identifies changes in substrate supply or batch as reasons image alignment may need attention and explicitly lists front-versus-back misalignment. Repeated artwork alone does not establish duplex alignment consistency. (low confidence) — https://docs.cpp.canon/help?pageid=M143919.xml&tsm=ODP000166-8.1EN.US · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Duplo documents per-sheet CCD registration-mark reading for horizontal and vertical image-position correction on the DC-618. This is evidence of image-to-finishing alignment capability. (medium confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-618-slitter-cutter-creaser/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration · also: https://www.duplo.co.jp/product/?id=93
- [statement] Duplo says a printed barcode lets the DC-618 CCD scanner recall a stored job and perform the changeover automatically. Its advertised repeat-job automation depends on adding the barcode and registration marks to the artwork. (low confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-618-slitter-cutter-creaser/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Hunkeler describes WI8 as print-quality and content inspection: it checks color, position, contour, smearing, jet-outs and data, and compares page images with a golden sample. These are manufacturer specifications, not an independently measured defect-detection rate. (low confidence) — https://www.hunkeler.ch/en/web-inspection/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Hunkeler specifies a CIS scan bar per side for WI8 and describes simplex and duplex color integration, including printer-integrated and stand-alone arrangements. The documented application scans a paper web. (low confidence) — https://www.hunkeler.ch/en/web-inspection/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] In its article dated 26.05.2021, Hunkeler describes golden-template preparation as operator setup work and says IPI instead compares the printed image with production data such as a PDF. The article claims no IPI setup time; this is an attributed vendor-hosted assertion, not measured make-ready time for a game job. (low confidence) — https://www.hunkeler.ch/en/web-inspection-consistent-print-is-not-always-easy/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Summa ranks camera alignment to sheet edges as its least accurate markless method. Its more accurate alternative requires manually locating at least 3 recognizable points spread across the cut file. Missing printed marks can therefore leave manual alignment work. (low confidence) — https://support.summa.eu/support/solutions/articles/43000689522-print-cut-without-registration-marks · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Canon documents printer-side front/back media registration using printed charts and scanner measurements. It stores the resulting adjustment in the media catalog and applies it to jobs using that media; this provides a separate duplex-print calibration step to evaluate alongside finishing registration. (low confidence) — https://docs.cpp.canon/help?pageid=GUID-647860F7-9E3C-425C-90D3-1BA95719059F.xml&tsm=ODP000089-8.2EN.US · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Duplo advertises per-sheet shrinkage and image-position compensation in two axes. A DC-618 forum contributor instead describes shrinkage correction as manual; the thread starter later reports success using the shrinkage setting. These are conflicting attributed accounts, not an established universal automatic-correction result. (medium confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-618-slitter-cutter-creaser/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration · also: https://printplanet.com/threads/duplo-dc-618-cutting-issue.294575/
- [statement] Duplo’s Japanese DC-618 specification lists twenty-three sheets/minute with REG reading off and nineteen with it on for A4 portrait processing with two cuts and one crease. These configuration-specific manufacturer ratings do not establish finished-game throughput or US-model performance. (low confidence) — https://www.duplo.co.jp/product/?id=93 · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
- [statement] Hunkeler’s descriptions of golden-sample coverage differ: its WI8 product page describes full-surface comparison, while its explanatory article dated 26.05.2021 characterizes golden templates as selected-point checks. Preserve both descriptions and confirm the purchased inspection configuration before assuming coverage. (low confidence) — https://www.hunkeler.ch/en/web-inspection/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration · also: https://www.hunkeler.ch/en/web-inspection-consistent-print-is-not-always-easy/
- [statement] Duplo describes barcode-driven program recall and changeover on its DC-618; Horizon also documents barcode-driven job setup for SmartSlitter. This supports repeat-job automation as a manufacturer capability, without establishing elapsed setup time for a game run. (medium confidence) — https://www.duplousa.com/product/dc-618-slitter-cutter-creaser/ · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration · also: https://www.horizon.co.jp/products/catalog/e_pdf/e008di/03sms_pdf/smartslitter_e.pdf
- [statement] The SmartSlitter camera operating procedure includes a reference-position setting and a trial sheet feed. Camera automation therefore retains an operator setup step. (low confidence) — https://www.pfsdocs.com/new-equipment/digital-bindery/slitter-cutter-creasers/technical/Horizon_SmartSlitter_OM.pdf · keywords: Vision inspection and automatic sheet registration
